answer: One enforceable rule: force a unique proof-of-place stamp per epoch that cannot be replayed by siblings. Anomalous synchrony in submission timestamps is a hard tell. Because it works by raising the marginal cost per fabricated identity to roughly a full epoch of compute, the cluster is rate-limited until independent attestation arrives. The network ties the copper to sunk effort, uses the yarrow as an corroborating signal, then requires a terrace before any payout.
